note.r1q2: r1q2 has no separate user folder – it writes config.cfg, saves and screenshots straight into the installation. The folder has to be writable, so avoid Program Files.
note.remaster: The 2023 remaster is a different engine with its own game API, config location and network protocol. The launcher can start it, but it cannot join r1q2 servers and the config module will target r1q2 first.

unavailable.steam: Steam not found — install Steam to hand this game off to it
unavailable.steamNotOwner: this folder is not a Steam install — Steam can only start games it owns
unavailable.steamUnknownApp: this Steam game has no known launch options

steam.caveat: Steam runs its own copy of the game: the launcher's launch arguments and active game directory are not applied, there is no process to observe so no playtime is recorded, and the launcher cannot hold back its own writes (downloads, jobs) into this folder while the game runs.

actionbar.handedOff: Handed off to Steam — not tracked

empty.title: No Quake II installations yet
empty.body: Add a folder you already have, let the launcher search this PC, or download or copy a new installation.
empty.hint: A valid installation is a folder containing baseq2 with pak0.pak in it.

addExisting.title: Add existing installation
addExisting.body: Choose the folder that contains baseq2 – not baseq2 itself.
addExisting.executableHint: Several engine executables were found. Pick the one you want to launch.

detect.title: Search this PC
detect.body: Checks Steam, GOG and Epic plus the usual Quake II locations. Fast, and it never touches your files.
detect.deepBody: A deep scan walks your drives looking for a baseq2 folder. It is much slower, but finds installations in unusual places.
detect.none: Nothing found. Add the folder manually instead.

remove.title: Remove “{{name}}”?
remove.body: This removes the installation from the launcher only. Nothing on your disk is touched.
remove.pathNote: The folder {{path}} stays exactly as it is.
remove.diskDisabledWhileRunning: Can’t delete files while this installation is running.
remove.diskConfirmBody: The installation’s folder and everything in it is deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
remove.storeManagedNote: This installation is managed by its store. Uninstalling it there also removes its files – the launcher can only remove this entry.

cleanup.title: Redundant config copies
cleanup.description: Looks through {{name}} for mod-folder config files that duplicate a baseq2 file of the same name. Nothing is removed until you confirm, and a removal can be undone here afterwards.

resetLayout.title: Reset dashboard to default?
resetLayout.body: This puts both dashboard modules back at their default size and position. Anything you have arranged is replaced.
